name: LeaderDotMenuList
job: Present menu items or services as a typeset price list with dotted leaders; focusing a row unfolds its description and lights its leader
visitor_action: hover or focus a row to light its leader; click, tap or press Enter to unfold its description (one open at a time); arrow keys move between rows
mobile: tap a row to expand, one open at a time; type steps down in narrow containers
motion: leader dots fill in sequence toward the price, price warms to the accent, description unfolds with eased height (reduced-motion: all descriptions visible, no transitions)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: removed IntersectionObserver entrance fade that left rows invisible in the 375 iframe shot)
checks.craft: pass (3, after 1 polish pass: narrower type and leader below 440px so names stop wrapping at 375)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Bistro ivory: ivory menu stock, ink-navy serif with small caps, brick-red leader dots, thin double rule
notes: Serif relies on system fonts (Palatino/Georgia fallback), so small caps are synthesized; the leader fill sweeps left-to-right even in right-to-left languages.
